entries.30afa9f480623f3d: The company expects the market for prepared food home delivery to expand, but the operating environment is harsh, as rising prices are heightening consumer cost-consciousness and soaring fuel costs are increasing transportation costs. Within this environment, it is positioned as a company that delivers dinner ingredients mainly to general households in part of the Chūbu and Kansai regions, which are its base areas.
entries.3b3b6322c65adeae: This business delivers evening meal ingredients and sells food for business use. Home delivery of evening meal ingredients is provided to general households in Aichi, Gifu and Mie Prefectures in the Chubu region, and in parts of Kyoto, Osaka and Shiga Prefectures in the Kansai region. It uses an integrated delivery system in which products are manufactured at the company's own factories and sold and delivered by sales staff, and it also conducts food research and product development. Sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥5,512 million for menu products and ¥495 million for special-offer products.

entries.6e017cf5c53cf169: This business model is built mainly on home delivery of dinner ingredients and similar items, integrating manufacturing of products at its own factories with delivery and sales by sales staff, and also includes selling food products to corporate customers such as nursing care facilities.
entries.878532da5cb33d8d: It defines its corporate concept as 'delivery of fresh ingredients' and aims to develop as a comprehensive food sales company, with home delivery for individual customers as its core business. It states that it will expand its sales channels by improving delivery efficiency and sales structures within existing areas, and will also work to enrich its menu offerings. As a company serving as the last-mile delivery arm of the Shinmei Group, it states that it pursues safe, secure and delicious ingredients that meet customer needs, and that it will actively pursue new businesses to become second and third pillars, including alliances with peer companies, strengthening its own private brand (PB) products and expanding into the Kansai region.
